annotations.text: Kentico brand palette (brand.kentico.com): accent = Violet 60 #AF00FA (5:1 on white, AA for links), hover/dark = Violet 70 #7F09B7, highlight marks = Violet 20 #EBD8FF, chip/hover tint = Violet 10 #F7F1FF. Heritage Orange #F05A22 fails AA for link text (~3:1), so it stays out of the interactive default; a host wanting it swaps one token. Editorial spin kept: highlighter-underline marks, 2px facet rules, tabular counts, micro-labels, underline pagination.

New vs. today's default template (needs your approval):
1. Breadcrumb/section path line on the result card
2. Content-type micro-label (accent, uppercase)
3. Facet value counts right-aligned
4. Filetype icon slot for documents/PDFs
5. Richer no-results states (clear-filters shortcut, did-you-mean, popular searches)
6. Keyboard-hint footer on autocomplete
7. Mobile Filter & Sort sheet with live 'Show N results' apply button

Below 1024px the facet sidebar becomes the Filter & Sort button (active count badge) + scrolling chips; load-more replaces pagination. The sheet shows a pending Product selection, so its apply button previews 8 of the current 14.

Sample scenario is consistent throughout: query 'coffee grinder', Category: Grinders filter active, 14 results (Product 8 / Article 3 / Page 2 / Document 1). Version picker: v1 = Satellite-style blue, v2 = terracotta editorial, v3 = Kentico violet (current).
